# GenerateSpecMetadata

## Rules
- Input `specId` (`core/change`, `billing:invoices/create`); return `{ metadata: SpecMetadata, hasExtraction: boolean }`: extracted fields, hashes, canonical `dependsOn`, implementation, fresh optimizations, exact-call `provenance`.
- Resolve schema `SchemaProvider.get()`; propagate `SchemaNotFoundError`/`SchemaValidationError`. No `metadataExtraction` → `{ metadata: {}, hasExtraction: false }`.
- Parse with `parseSpecId()`; select workspace `SpecRepository`. Unknown workspace → `WorkspaceNotFoundError`; missing `get()` → `SpecNotFoundError`.
- For schema artifacts with `scope: spec`: filename = final `output` segment; format `inferFormat()` or `plaintext`; parser `ArtifactParserRegistry`; content `SpecRepository.artifact()`. Skip absent parser/content.
- Await `extractMetadata()` using schema declarations, ASTs keyed artifact ID, renderers, shared `ExtractorTransformRegistry`, caller-owned origin context. Results (`title`, `description`, `dependsOn`, `keywords`, `rules`, `constraints`, `scenarios`, `context`) already normalized; repository-backed transforms allowed, extraction engine never infers filesystem paths.
- `dependsOn`: extracted candidate; call `readPersistedState(spec)` once. State exists → persisted value; non-empty differing extracted value → explicit failure. Absent → extracted or `[]`. Normalize only declared transforms; unnormalizable found values fail, never drop.
- One persisted snapshot per generation for `dependsOn`, implementation, optimizations, `provenance.persistedStateHash`; hash `persistedStateMeta(spec, { includeHash: true })?.hash ?? null` or same snapshot `originalHash`; never removed `persistedStateHash(spec)`, never mix/reread snapshots.
- Include each persisted `optimizedDescription`/`optimizedContext` only if fresh against same-call artifacts + schema; omit stale/absent. Never regenerate/invalidate/mutate.
- SHA-256 `ContentHasher.hash()` each loaded artifact; `contentHashes` keyed resolved filename; exclude unloaded. Return extraction + canonical dependencies + implementation + fresh optimizations + hashes + `generatedBy: core` + provenance (artifact hashes/lastModified, persisted state hash/null, schema identity, projection version/fingerprint), `hasExtraction: true`.
- Config `createGenerateSpecMetadata(config, options?)` calls `resolveGenerateSpecMetadataDeps(resolver)`, then canonical `createGenerateSpecMetadata(deps)`; resolver provides `listWorkspaces`, `schemaProvider`, `parsers`, `hasher`, `extractorTransforms`, `workspaceRoutes`; no inline fs-shaped wiring.

## Constraints
- Deterministic schema extraction; no LLM. `GenerateSpecMetadata` orchestrates; async `extractMetadata()` owns extraction.
- Read-only: never disk/persisted writes or `SpecRepository.writeMetadataSnapshot()`/`writePersistedState()`; persistence belongs `MaterializeSpecMetadata` and internal `PersistSpecMetadata`.
- Optimization freshness only same-call artifacts, schema, persisted snapshot.
